PropFirms.noRecordedExpenses: No recorded expenses in this selection.
PropFirms.noCashMovements: No cash movements in this selection.
PropFirms.grossSpendingNote: Gross spending by category. Refunds appear separately in the summary.
PropFirms.renewalReminderNote: Reminders do not create expenses or charge your card. Update the next date after reviewing a renewal.
PropFirms.searchPlaceholder: Search firm, account, reference or status
PropFirms.ledgerNote: Expenses and refunds use cash dates; payout rows use request dates. Export cash CSV for individual settlement dates. Payout requests do not count as income.
PropFirms.how1: Net cash return = actual payout receipts − payout reversals + expense refunds − spending. Net spend = spending − refunds. ROI = net cash return ÷ net spend; it is unavailable when net spend is zero or negative.
PropFirms.how2: Amounts use each currency’s minor units. Currencies are never converted or combined automatically. Your firm’s actual approval, payout rules and bank statement remain authoritative.
PropFirms.how3: Past attempts, breached accounts and archived accounts stay in cash returns. Shared firm costs are included in firm totals but are not silently allocated to individual accounts.
PropFirms.how4: Requests and reminders never move money. This tracker does not place trades, connect banks, infer payout eligibility, or change journal trading P&L. JSON exports in Settings include these records and their audit history; copy the data directory to preserve attachment files too.

account.description: Keep each evaluation, reset attempt and funding phase as its own record. Account size is nominal capital, not money you spent.
account.renewalNote: A reminder only. Record an expense when charged; nothing is charged or added automatically.

entry.payoutDescription: A request is not income. Record actual bank receipts separately, including partial payments. This does not request a payout from your firm.
entry.spendingDescription: Record cash that actually changed hands. Include taxes and fees in the amount paid. Do not duplicate trading commissions already included elsewhere.
entry.splitNote: If your amount is already after the firm split, enter 100% and only fees still to be deducted. Never deduct the split twice.
entry.refundNote: Linked expense: {id}. Refunds reduce costs and are shown separately from payout income.

receipt.title: Record payout cash movement
receipt.description: Record the actual net amount credited or returned in {currency}. If your bank converted currencies, use the statement's original-currency amount; this tracker does not invent an exchange rate.
receipt.note: Keep the request open for partial payments. Once the final payment arrives, edit the payout status to Completed; a difference from the expected amount remains visible.

change.archiveDescription: Archiving hides the account from the active list. Its cash history remains in returns. You can restore it later.
change.voidDescription: Voided records stay in the audit trail and are excluded from cash totals. They can be restored. Voiding a payout also excludes its receipts.

import.title: Import prop cash CSV
import.description: Import settled expenses, refunds and net payouts. Preview validates every row; an import is all-or-nothing and repeated stable IDs are skipped.
import.note: Use kind expense, refund or payout; date YYYY-MM-DD; positive amount in currency units. A payout amount is cash already received after splits and fees. Payouts need account_id from an account’s Details. A refund’s expense_id references its original CSV row ID. Put expenses before their refunds. This is not a broker statement importer.
import.tooLarge: Use a CSV up to 2 MB / 1,000 rows.

demo.note: Simulated demo data. Fictional firm, fees and payouts.

PropFirms.payoutsNote: Open requests always remain visible. Completed, rejected and cancelled requests use the request-date filter. Expected amounts are after your share and withheld fees; actual amounts come only from receipts.

MarketData.title: Market data
MarketData.description: Connect historical prices for estimated MAE/MFE and candle replay on closed trades. Vela renders the charts. No data source is enabled or selected by default. Choose a connection or upload your own candles. Market data connections are separate from broker sync and AI.
MarketData.encryptedNote: Credentials are encrypted locally and used only by the server for market data. Saved secrets are never returned to the browser or included in journal exports.
MarketData.completeFields: Complete all required fields in the server environment.
MarketData.testPublicReachable: Public endpoint reachable. No API key or paid data plan is required. Candle availability depends on the pair, date range and public API limits.
MarketData.testVerified: Connection verified. Instrument coverage depends on your provider access.
MarketData.saveSuccess: Credentials saved. Test the connection to verify access.
MarketData.csvDescription: Upload one instrument and candle resolution per file, up to 5 MB / 50,000 rows. Required columns: time, open, high, low, close. Volume is optional. Time is the bar open: ISO-8601 with timezone, Unix seconds or milliseconds. Daily bars must start at 00:00 UTC. These are market candles, separate from trade execution imports.
MarketData.fileTooLarge: Use a CSV smaller than 5 MB.
MarketData.symbolPlaceholder: Exact symbol used in your file
MarketData.importSuccess: Market candles imported. Choose Market data CSV on a trade or in Reports.
MarketData.removeSuccessCsv: Dataset and its saved estimates removed.

london-strategic-edge.description: Historical candles. Stock and ETF prices are split adjusted; coverage depends on your plan.
london-strategic-edge.symbolHint: Use the exact provider symbol, including the futures contract or currency pair.

alpaca.description: US stocks and crypto. Choose a stock or crypto feed; SIP requires appropriate data access. Stock prices are unadjusted.
alpaca.symbolHint: Stocks: AAPL. Crypto: BTC/USD; choose the Crypto dataset.

binance.description: Public Binance spot candles. No API key required. Availability depends on your region and the listed pair.
binance.symbolHint: Spot pairs use BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT. USDT is not USD; account and quote currencies must match for estimates.

coinbase.description: Public Coinbase Exchange spot candles. No API key required; intervals without trades may have no candle.
coinbase.symbolHint: Use a Coinbase Exchange product such as BTC-USD or ETH-USD.

oanda.description: Forex and CFD candles from your v20 account. Midpoint prices, UTC-aligned bars and tick-count volume; no spread or FX conversion is included.
oanda.symbolHint: Use an OANDA instrument such as EUR_USD. Set the contract multiplier in Settings to match the units in your fills.

AI.title: Ask your journal
AI.placeholder: Why do my Monday shorts keep failing?
suggestions: Which weekday should I stop trading?
Am I better at longs or shorts?

notConfigured.title: Set up AI to continue
notConfigured.description: Connect an Anthropic or OpenAI API key in Settings to ask questions, generate recaps, and review trades.

authError.title: Check your AI connection
authError.description: Your AI provider couldn’t verify your key or permissions. Review them in Settings, then try again.

billing.title: Your AI account needs attention
billing.description: Check the billing, credit balance, or quota on your AI provider account, then try again.

modelUnavailable.title: Check your AI model
modelUnavailable.description: Check the model ID and your provider account’s access in Settings.

rateLimit.title: AI is temporarily busy
rateLimit.description: Please wait a moment before trying again. Your journal data hasn’t changed.

journalEmpty.title: Add trades to get started
journalEmpty.description: AI insights use your journal history. Import your trades, then ask your question again.

noTradesToRecap.title: No trades to recap yet
noTradesToRecap.description: A recap needs at least one closed trade on this day. You can still write your own day note.

unauthorized.title: Please sign in again
unauthorized.description: Your session may have expired. Sign in to continue using your journal.

network.title: Couldn’t connect to AI
network.description: Check your connection and try again. Your journal data hasn’t changed.

generic.title: Couldn’t complete the AI request
generic.description: Please try again in a moment. If this continues, check your AI settings.

settings.title: AI (bring your own key)
settings.description: Use Anthropic or OpenAI for recaps, trade critiques, and “ask your journal”. Your key is encrypted at rest. AI requests go from your server directly to the provider you select.
settings.modelHint: Use a text model available to your provider account. Each provider keeps its own model and key.
settings.envKeyHint: Using {env} from the server environment. Change or remove that variable on the server to update the key.
settings.keepKeyHint: Leave blank to keep your saved key, or enter a replacement.
settings.addKeyHint: Add your API key, then save to use this provider.

dailyChart.ariaLabel: Daily net profit and loss. Exact values and trade links are available in the table below.

drawdown.title: Relative drawdown
drawdown.empty: Set an initial balance to chart relative drawdown.

rolling.ariaWinRate: Win rate over 20-trade windows. Exact values and links follow below.
rolling.ariaAvgNetPnl: Average net P&L over 20-trade windows. Exact values and links follow below.

scatter.ariaLabel: Individual trade outcomes. Select a point to inspect; all trades also have links in the table below.
